scientific_integrity: The originating polynomial map, its near-integrable dynamics, and collision parameter are credited to published literature. The asserted additional exact conditional-area law, stochastic order, reciprocity, moments and cubic flux follow from a self-contained proof and tests; originality cannot be certified independently.
scientific_limitations: Exact probability and integrated-flux formulas are restricted to zero-kick integrable dynamics and natural area conditioned on the finite negative-lift band.
The conjugacy extends to nonzero kicks but may transform the kick beyond a specified physical parameter box.
No ensemble exists on the vanished band at epsilon=1; the beta law is a two-sided weak limit.
A same-map public index result on integer-winding fixed-point counts could not be inspected in complete text; the compared abstract does not imply a continuous area-weighted rotation law.
The assertions concern real lift rotations, not rotation numbers modulo one; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Reciprocal dynamical symmetry and an exact two-sided rotation-depth law at a shearless collision
